issue: Invalid salary range (min > max) accepted without validation
actual: Posted a job "QA Test Engineer" with Minimum Salary 90000 and Maximum Salary 60000 (min > max). The form submitted successfully with a "Job posted successfully!" toast and the job now appears in the dashboard as "Remote · $90k - $60k · Posted Yesterday" with no error or rejection for the invalid salary range.

Current date is Aug 25, 2026. An application submitted moments ago on job-1 shows date "Yesterday" instead of "Today". A job posted moments ago ("QA Test Engineer") shows "Posted Yesterday" instead of "Posted Today". Both dates are inaccurate relative to the current date.

evidence: Posted "QA Test Engineer" job with title, industry (Technology), employment type (Full-time), location (Remote), salary, description, and skill "Testing". New listing appeared in employer dashboard job list and in the public job-seeker listing (results count increased from 8 to 9, new card "job-1787661851773" visible).
Home page lists 9 job cards matching "Showing 9 jobs" count; clicking a card (job-1) navigated to /jobs/job-1 and displayed full job details.

Industry=Healthcare alone → 1 job (job-3). Industry=Healthcare + Location=San Francisco combined → 0 jobs (no-results). Job Type=Part-time alone → 1 job (job-6, Part-Time Content Writer). Clear filters button restored full list of 9 jobs.

Each filter change immediately updated the visible job list and "Showing N jobs" count without requiring page reload; combining Healthcare+San Francisco filters produced "Showing 0 jobs" and a "No jobs found" message; clicking Clear filters restored "Showing 9 jobs".

Search "REACT" (uppercase) matched job-1 via skill "React". Search "techcorp" (lowercase) matched 3 jobs by company "TechCorp Solutions". Search "nurse" matched job-3 by title "Registered Nurse". Results and count updated immediately without reload.

issue: No edit functionality exists for published jobs
actual: Searched the employer dashboard job cards and job detail page for an edit control. Each dashboard job card only exposes an "applications" toggle button and a delete button (no data-semtag edit action, no icon/button with "edit" label/title anywhere in the DOM). Clicking the job title does not navigate to an edit form. There is no UI path to edit a published job's details.

evidence: Clicking delete on "Part-Time Content Writer" opened confirmation dialog "Delete this job? This will permanently delete... and all its applications". Cancel preserved the job. Confirming Delete removed job-6 from employer dashboard (Active Jobs count 5→4) and from the job-seeker listing (job-6 no longer present in jobs.list).

issue: Data does not persist across page reload
actual: After deleting job-6 ("Part-Time Content Writer") it was removed from both dashboard and job-seeker list. After reloading the page, job-6 reappeared in the job-seeker listing as if never deleted. Similarly, a newly posted job ("QA Test Engineer") and newly submitted applications (Test User, Test User Duplicate) disappeared after a page reload, reverting to only the original seed data. All in-memory changes (published jobs, submitted applications, job deletions) are lost on reload.
